titre: Vacance des centres commerciaux aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Taux de vacance national et moyenne historique, en pourcentage, du quatrième trimestre 2025 au deuxième trimestre 2026

T4 2025.texte: The overall national vacancy rate finished the year at 5.7%, up 40 basis points (bps) from Q4 2024 (5.3%).

T1 2026.texte: National vacancy rose 10 basis points (bps) quarter-over-quarter (QOQ) to 5.9% but remains well below its historical average of 7.4%.

T2 2026.texte: National vacancy increased just three basis points quarter-over-quarter to 6.0%, remaining well below the historical average of 7.4%.
